description: The journey to the neighboring planet traces a path connecting Nikola Tesla, Nazi weapons of war, a Cold War space race, and a string of blockbuster discoveries made by some of NASA's most talented robots.

description: At secret test centers deep inside the WWII Germany, engineers were pondering concepts far ahead of their time; Germany's incredible Miniature Fighter Competition led to some true aeronautical marvels.

title: Vice Admiral Robert F. Dunn, Naval Aviator
description: Vice Admiral Robert F. Dunn, former Commander of the Naval Air Force Atlantic Fleet, started his commissioned service on board the escort destroyer Nicholas during the Korean War; he would earn his wings in 1953 and go on to fly A-1 Skyraiders.
